title: Austin Hospital Authority Study & Public Input
summary:
*   A special briefing was held to discuss a **hospital authority feasibility study**, presented by Deloitte & Touche.
*   Citizens had an opportunity for **public input**, with up to 10 speakers able to comment on policy briefings.
*   The meeting was a brief, one-hour session, primarily focused on the potential hospital authority.
